mission: Smallest possible ploader PRX probe that decides, by its staged launch, whether /data/plugins/UE4SS.log is writable from a ploader-loaded module and whether /data/modbridge/roots/PPSA33286/loadlist.txt is readable from the game process. Rules the output path in/out as a blocker for the composed runtime.

recipe.base: worker-v3-startup-diag diag igd1 minimal variant (build_ingame.py pipeline reused exactly: import_references-first ld -r combine, SharpProspero Packager.dll, frozen finalize_sdk.py SDK 0x11000000 stamp, pinned make_fself, two-run determinism, artifact checker gates)

import_table.added_row_source: verbatim frozen-191-contract row, copied byte-identical from .superpowers/native-dependency-spike/native-full-runtime-aligned-entry-1/import-contract.json (same provenance family as getpid/clock_gettime: libScePosix POSIX-name row, ModuleName libkernel; the aligned-entry module that carried all 191 verbatim rows loaded on console)
import_table.rationale: The mission requires a real 16-byte read; sceKernelRead is NOT in the frozen 191-row contract, so the POSIX-name row `read` is the only verbatim-contract way to perform it. This is the ONLY delta from the igd1 import set and is loudly labeled as first-use-in-lineage (never yet invoked on console by this lineage, though its identity is from the console-loaded 191-row set).

recipe.module_start_contract: guard -> open UE4SS.log O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_APPEND -> build+write PATH_TEST line (monotonic-ns boot timestamp via clock_gettime) -> open loadlist.txt O_RDONLY, read 16 bytes via `read` -> build ACTIVATION_TEST line with hex (or exact failure + errno via __error) -> write both lines -> close -> return 0 ALWAYS. No threads, no ctor walk, no C++, no experiments.

claims.determinism_two_runs: intended and scripted; result recorded in REPORT.md only after actual run
claims.writability_conclusion: DEFERRED to the staged launch: UE4SS.log appearing with the PATH_TEST line = path writable (composed-runtime failure is elsewhere); no file/no line = path ruled a blocker OR module did not start (disambiguation steps in STAGE-PLAN.md section 5)

bounds.existing_files_elsewhere: read-only; vendored sources copied, originals untouched
bounds.console_access: none from this worker (no network/console rule); launch is user-coordinated per standing ritual and encoded in STAGE-PLAN.md
bounds.ploader_ini: not modified by this worker; exact one-line addition provided in STAGE-PLAN.md
